agent_output.affected_group: Aircraft operators and pilots using Colored Federal airway B-8 between Shishmaref (SHH) and Tin City (TNC), Alaska; aviation industry/users of the Alaskan en route NDB navigation structure
agent_output.change_summary: FAA notice of proposed rulemaking to revoke Colored Federal airway Blue 8 (B-8) in its entirety near Shishmaref, AK, because the Shishmaref (SHH) Non-directional Beacon is scheduled for decommissioning, which would render B-8 unusable; loss to be mitigated by a planned future US Area Navigation Route. Comments due May 16, 2022. No effective date set; proposal only.

evidence.quote:
SUMMARY: This action proposes to revoke Colored Federal airway Blue 8 
(B-8) in the vicinity of Shishmaref, AK due to the pending 
decommissioning of

Colored Federal airway B-8 navigates from SHH to the Tin City, AK, 
(TNC) NDB. The decommissioning of SHH would render B-8 unusable. This 
proposal would revoke B-8 in its entirety. The loss of B-8 would be 
mitigated by a planned future United States Area Navigation Route.

The aviation industry/users have indicated a desire for the FAA to 
transition the Alaskan en route navigation structure away from the 
dependency on NDBs.

this is a routine matter that will only affect air traffic procedures 
and air navigation
DATES: Comments must be received on or before May 16, 2022.

The proposal contained in this action may be changed in light of 
comments received.
